title: Fleet Program Points on Store Replacement Authorizations
content:
A vehicle on a Crestline Fleet Account roster earns fleet-program points when the holder of a Road Hazard Protection certificate authorizes a store replacement of one of its tires.

**Authorization fleet-program points.** A vehicle whose latest roster enrollment entry has no later removal entry, on a Crestline Fleet Account in status active whose program carries the Crestline national fleet price file, adds 4 points to the authorization coverage percentage; such a vehicle on an active fleet account whose program has no national price file adds 2 points; any other vehicle adds no fleet-program points.

| Open roster enrollment | Fleet account status | National price file on the program | Points |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | active | yes | 4 |
| yes | active | no | 2 |
| yes | not active | — | 0 |
| no (removed after the latest enrollment, or never enrolled) | — | — | 0 |
